# ProSync

> Last-checked: 2026-09-28 (158+ tests passing: 158 pytest unit & contract tests + 29 node companion tests | 100% green)

Canonical repository: https://github.com/file-bricks/ProSync
Organization: file-bricks
Primary language: Python
UI stack: PySide6 desktop system-tray application
License: MIT
Attribution Notice: NOTICE
Security Policy: SECURITY.md (Local-First, Zero-Egress, SQLite WAL Invariants, § 521 BGB Gefälligkeitsrecht, 48h SLA)
Marketing & Governance Log: MARKETING-LOG.txt
Third-Party Licenses: THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md (SPDX audited, Level 1 SBOM INV-LOCAL-01..INV-SLA-10, unprivileged RunAsInvoker)

ProSync is an intelligent backup synchronization tool with built-in SQLite database protection. It runs as a Windows system-tray app and supports folder sync, file sync, scheduled backups, and batch operations.

Core behavior:

- Synchronizes folders and individual files in five configurable modes: mirror, update, two_way, one_way, index_only.
- Detects and protects SQLite databases automatically (WAL checkpoint before copy, WAL file exclusion).
- Supports scheduled backups with configurable intervals, daily local execution, and a batch-sync queue for multiple connections.
- Provides a headless CLI for automation: `--list`, `--run <id|name>`, `--all`, `--config`, and `--quiet`.
- Exports redacted `prosync-profile-v1.json` for device companions and web PWA integration.
- Standardized 8-point platform smoke test suites for Linux and macOS (`tests/linux_platform_smoke.py`, `tests/macos_platform_smoke.py`).
- Windows Store staged MSIX packaging with desktop AppxManifest, full tile asset sets, and automated readiness audit (`scripts/check_store_readiness.py`).
- Optionally launches ProFiler companion for indexing and search across synchronized files.
- Multilingual localization support compliant with Policy P-006 Tier-2 (DE, EN, ES, ZH, JA, RU) with deterministic 4-tier fallback and automated translation catalog verification (`manage_translations.py --check`).
- Automated repository contract and metadata parity suite (`tests/test_metadata.py`).
- Comprehensive marketing, discovery, and governance log (`MARKETING-LOG.txt`) with competitive matrix and 10 runtime invariant pillars.
- Trilingual 18-point quick navigation parity across `README.md`, `README_de.md`, and `README.es.md` with reciprocal dual HTML anchors `sec-01`..`sec-18`.

Privacy boundary:

- ProSync does not transmit any data. All sync operations run locally (Zero-Egress).
- `ProSync_config.json` with personal source/target paths is excluded from the repository.
- The tracked `ProSync_config.example.json` contains only an empty template structure.

Local verification:

```bash
python -m pytest -ra -v       # 158 Python tests
cd web_companion && npm test  # 29 Node PWA companion tests (187 total tests)
python scripts/check_store_readiness.py # Windows Store readiness auditor
python run_tests.py           # 21 test suites locally
python -m compileall -q ProSyncStart_V3.1.py ProSyncReader.py prosync_utils.py
```

## Audience

- Windows users who need reliable, scheduled backup sync between local or network folders
- Developers and power users managing SQLite databases who need safe, consistent backups
- Privacy-conscious users who want a local-only sync tool with no cloud dependency
- Users of the file-bricks suite looking for ProFiler companion integration
